next.reason: 1985: "If the execution of the WRITE statement is unsuccessful for a reason other than an invalid key condition"; 2023: "If control is returned from those statements, then control is transferred to the end of the input-output statement.". Both run NOT INVALID KEY on success. On a failure that is not invalid key, 1985 still runs it after the USE procedure; 2023 goes to the end of the statement instead.
